keySentence: The angry giant chased Jack all the way down.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The giant followed Jack. Jack climbed down fast. Mother was waiting. The angry giant chased Jack all the way down.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack climbed down the beanstalk as fast as he could. The angry giant chased Jack all the way down the beanstalk. The beanstalk was shaking from the giant's heavy weight. Jack's hands were slippery but he did not let go. Mother was waiting below, shouting for Jack to hurry. The giant's enormous hands were reaching closer and closer.
